title: Stilt Houses in Aurora
description: A surreal snowy landscape features a row of whimsical, multi-colored houses built on tall mechanical stilts. The houses have glowing windows, smoking chimneys, and are connected by flowing colorful ribbons across a pale frozen ground under a starry purple sky with green aurora.
prompt: A surreal winter scene with a line of colorful, quirky houses elevated on long mechanical stilts marching across a snowy plain. The houses feature glowing orange windows, smoking chimneys, and decorative details. Flowing ribbons in purple, blue and orange weave between the structures. The night sky is filled with stars and a vibrant green and purple aurora, in a whimsical fantasy painting style.
